_grammar: rules/class_abilities.py, module docstring. The engine reads these fields and never these names.
_energy_note: Positive or negative energy follows alignment in the book, and the app has no alignment (the 2026-09-19 ruling). Positive is the default; a cleric whose `class_choices` say "channel energy": "negative" channels negative, which swaps who is healed and who is harmed.

abilities.name: Channel Energy
abilities.source: CRB p.40 Channel Energy: 3 + Cha a day; 1d6 + 1d6 per two levels beyond 1st; 30-ft radius on the cleric; standard action; positive heals the living or harms undead (Will DC 10 + 1/2 level + Cha for half); the cleric may include herself.
abilities.text: Heal the living or harm the undead in a 30-ft burst.
not_yet: With no map, everyone in the scene is in the burst.
Excluding chosen creatures (Selective Channeling): the burst takes everyone it reaches, as the book does.
